title: Zehra Ko Do Pursa
body:
Zehra Ko Do Pursa
Karbobala ke dasht me be aasra aale nabi
Maare gaye ansaar sab, zakhmi hua ibne ali
Munis nahi yawar nahi, ghaazi nahi akbar nahi
Bikhre pade hai ja baja, laashe kahi aur sar kahi
Matam karo ehle aza, ghar lut gaya shabbir ka
Purse ko aai sayyeda, matam karo ehle aza
Pursa bhare ghar ka hai ye, jo karbala me lut gaya
<<MINI>>
Hussain
ya hussain, hussain bekafan, hussain bekhata
Sab milke azadaro zehra ko do pursa..(2)
Barbaad hua ran me ghar aale payambar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek dopeher me lut gaya, maqdooma-e-alam ka ghar
Kaunain ki shehzadiya, nauha kuna hai nange sar
Tumse ali ki laadli, kehti hai ye sar peetkar
<<MINI>>
